# P08 Implementation options

- Requirement: Optional for all types. Use when proposing an internal approach
- Placement: The relevant discussion in the body
- Narrative role: Explains differences between approaches to obtaining the required result.
- Author: Proposer
- Reviewer: The implementation-owning team decides the method. Other teams confirm only conditions affecting shared contracts, cost or schedule
- Check: Has an attractive implementation been treated as an obligation for the other side? Are assumptions, measurements and estimated costs distinguished?

<!-- body:start -->
## Approaches to consider

We propose [approach] to obtain [required result]. We expect [effect] because of [premise], but [costs, risks or unconfirmed assumptions] remain. That effect is [measured, estimated or unmeasured].

Another method is [alternative]. We can compare [differences important to this judgment]. Delete this paragraph if there is no alternative.

Please have the implementation-owning team state whether it adopts, modifies or rejects the approach, and why. Any chosen method must satisfy [required external result and conditions to preserve].
<!-- body:end -->
